name: ScaleTableA
note: 64 rows x 64 bytes, each row starts at $40 and decreases; use not read in code yet

name: ScaleTableB
note: 64 rows x 64 bytes of ramps (row 0 = 0..63); use not read in code yet

name: AbsSineTable
note: 384 words |sin(n*pi/128)| * $10000, the peak stored as $0001; use not read in code yet

name: CheckSettingMode
note: reads hard DIP 1 (bit 0 of REG_DIPSW, 0 = on) and branches to TestModeEntry when it is on; MAME: setting mode DIP opens test mode

name: TestModeEntry
note: test mode start: clears system mode, RAM and both palette banks, sets up the BIOS RAM, then TestMenu

name: TestMenu
note: main menu: draws TestMenuText and the date, up/down moves the cursor, A selects (TestMenuSelect); MAME screen

name: TestMenuDrawCursor
note: erases the cursor at the old line, copies TestIndexNew to TestIndex, draws it at the new line

name: TestMenuCursorCmd
note: writes one MESS_OUT command for the cursor at line TestIndex (VRAM $70E5 + 3 x line)

name: PutBcdByte
note: appends a MESS_OUT command printing a BCD byte as two digits at VRAM d2; a leading 0 stays blank

name: TestMenuText
note: MESS_OUT data: the 7 menu lines and the date frame

name: PutWeekday
note: appends the 3-letter name of BIOS_WEEKDAY from WeekdayNames

name: WeekdayNames
note: SUN MON TUE WED THU FRI SAT, 4 bytes each ($FF ends a name)

name: TestMenuSelect
note: pushes TestMenu as the return address and jumps to TestMenuJumpTable[TestIndex]

name: TestMenuJumpTable
note: 7 entries in menu order: HardwareTest, TestHardDip, TestSoftDip, TestBookKeeping, TestCodeNumber, TestCalendar, TestMenuExit

name: TestMenuExit
note: EXIT: while hard DIP 1 is still on, shows "DIP-SW 1 OFF !!" and waits

name: TestHardDip
note: menu item: SETTING UP THE HARD DIP screen; ran only in that MAME scenario

name: TestSoftDip
note: menu item: SETTING UP THE CABINET (soft DIP) screen; ran only in that MAME scenario

name: TestBookKeeping
note: menu item: book keeping screen (CABINET/COIN, CABINET/PLAY); ran only in that MAME scenario

name: TestCodeNumber
note: menu item: CODE NUMBER SETTING screen; ran only in that MAME scenario

name: TestCodeNumberCard
note: writes the code number to the memory card (texts CODE NUMBER HAS BEEN SET. / THIS CARD IS INVALID.); not run with a card

name: TestCalendar
note: menu item: SETTING UP THE CALENDAR screen; ran only in that MAME scenario

name: HardwareTest
note: menu item 1: clears RAM and palettes, then calls HwTestStepTable[TestIndex] once per frame

name: HwTestStepTable
note: 14 entries: for each of the 7 screens a draw routine and a per-frame routine

name: HwTestCrosshatch
note: draws the crosshatch (palette and VRAM); MAME screen 1

name: HwTestCrosshatchFrame
note: per frame: START (bit 0 of ram_10FEDD) goes to step 2

name: HwTestColorBars
note: draws the RED GREEN BLUE WHITE bars; MAME screen 2

name: HwTestColorBarsFrame
note: per frame: START goes to step 4

name: HwTestIoCheck
note: draws the I/O CHECK screen; MAME screen 3

name: HwTestIoCheckFrame
note: per frame routine of the I/O check (inputs, DIPs, LED counters)

name: HwTestSound
note: draws the SOUND TEST screen; MAME screen 4

name: HwTestSoundFrame
note: per frame routine of the sound test

name: HwTestMemCard
note: draws the MEMORY CARD TEST screen; MAME screen 5

name: HwTestMemCardFrame
note: per frame routine of the memory card test (prints TEST OK / TEST ERROR)

name: HwTestBackupClear
note: draws the BACKUP CLEAR screen; MAME screen 6

name: HwTestBackupClearFrame
note: per frame routine of the backup clear (A+B+C)

name: HwTestCalendar
note: draws SETTING UP THE CALENDAR inside the hardware test; MAME screen 7

name: HwTestCalendarFrame
note: per frame routine of the hardware-test calendar

name: WaitFrame
note: sets ram_10FE8C to 1 and loops until it is cleared (I: cleared by the VBlank handler)

name: Reset
note: target of the reset vector and ENTRY_RESET

name: SystemInt1
note: target of SYSTEM_INT1 (VBlank routine called by games)
